mapper.select: SELECT cr.cr_id, cr.cr_product_id, cr.cr_seller_id, cr.cr_buyer_id, p.p_title, p.p_sale_status, pi.pi_storage, CASE WHEN p.p_sale_type = 'SALE' THEN p.p_sale_price ELSE COALESCE(w.b_amount, highest.highest_bid, a.a_start_price) END AS display_price, CASE WHEN p.p_sale_type = 'SALE' THEN '판매가' WHEN w.b_amount IS NOT NULL THEN '낙찰가' WHEN highest.highest_bid IS NULL THEN '시작가' WHEN a.a_status = 'OPEN' AND a.a_end_at > systimestamp THEN '현재 경매가' ELSE '마지막 입찰가' END AS price_label FROM chat_room cr JOIN product p ON p.p_id = cr.cr_product_id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON pi.pi_product_id = p.p_id LEFT JOIN auction a ON a.a_product_id = p.p_id LEFT JOIN bid w ON w.b_auction_id = a.a_id AND w.b_id = a.a_winning_bid_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b_auction_id, Max(b_amount) AS highest_bid FROM bid GROUP BY b_auction_id ) highest ON highest.b_auction_id = a.a_id WHERE cr.cr_seller_id = #{userId} OR cr.cr_buyer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.cr_created_at DESC, cr.cr_id DESC
